verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance's Scribe Agent can be scheduled to join incident calls. It transcribes them in real time and records key decisions, action items and events, which feed incident summaries and AI-generated post-incident reviews. Advance's generative AI also summarizes key incident information, so the core of 'AI writes the incident as it happens' is documented. Missing for 10: no evidence that AI drafts stakeholder or status-page updates, thin detail on how live summaries work during the incident, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
